Name: [F1] Rate/share measures must divide with DIVIDE or the F1.Rate UDF
Description: Seasons, drivers and circuits with zero starts are common once a slicer narrows the period (2011+ pit data, one-race drivers). A rate built with '/' errors or shows Infinity there; DIVIDE and the F1.Rate / F1.Share UDFs return blank. Exempt by name: averages of a stored rate (Avg ...), counts (Drivers for 80% of Wins), running/period-over-period helpers (Cumulative, Change vs PY, 5Y Avg, Prev Season, YoY).
Expression: RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)(rate|share|conversion|probability|%)") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)^avg |^drivers for|cumulative|change vs|5y avg|prev season|yoy|rank") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Expression, "DIVIDE|F1\.(Rate|Share)|\[[^\]]*(Rate|Share|%)[^\]]*\]")
